import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 15;
    static final int MAXM = 100005;
    static final int INF = 1_000_000_000;

    static int n, T;
    static char[][] grid;
    static char[][] target;
    static int[][] id;
    static int total;
    static int[][] distStart;
    static int[][] distTarget;

    static class Edge {
        int to, cap, flow;
        Edge(int t, int c) {
            to = t;
            cap = c;
            flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge> edgeList;
    static List<Integer>[] adj;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        adj[u].add(edgeList.size());
        edgeList.add(new Edge(v, cap));
        adj[v].add(edgeList.size());
        edgeList.add(new Edge(u, 0));
    }

    static boolean bfs(int sx, int sy, int[][] dist) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        if (sx >= 0 && sx < n && sy >= 0 && sy < n && grid[sx][sy] != '#') {
            dist[sx][sy] = 0;
            q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        }
        int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
        int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + dx[i];
                int ny = y + dy[i];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n &&
                    grid[nx][ny] >= '0' && grid[nx][ny] <= '9' &&
                    dist[nx][ny] > dist[x][y] + 1) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    static boolean[] level;
    static int[] current;

    static boolean buildLevelGraph() {
        Arrays.fill(level, false);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(2 * total + 1);
        level[2 * total + 1] = true;
        current[2 * total + 1] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int idx : adj[u]) {
                Edge e = edgeList.get(idx);
                if (!level[e.to] && e.cap > e.flow) {
                    level[e.to] = true;
                    current[e.to] = 0;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[2 * total + 2];
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == 2 * total + 2 || flow == 0) return flow;
        for (int i = current[u]; i < adj[u].size(); i++) {
            current[u] = i;
            int idx = adj[u].get(i);
            Edge e = edgeList.get(idx);
            if (level[e.to] && e.cap > e.flow) {
                int pushed = dfs(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.cap - e.flow));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.flow += pushed;
                    edgeList.get(idx ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (buildLevelGraph()) {
            Arrays.fill(current, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(2 * total + 1, INF)) > 0) {
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        grid = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
        target = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            grid[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            target[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }

        int sx = -1, sy = -1;
        id = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                    grid[i][j] = '0';
                }
                id[i][j] = ++total;
            }
        }

        distStart = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        bfs(sx, sy, distStart);

        final int source = 2 * total + 1;
        final int sink = source + 1;

        edgeList = new ArrayList<>();
        adj = new List[sink + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= sink; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] >= '1' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(source, id[i][j], grid[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (target[i][j] >= '1' && target[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(id[i][j] + total, sink, target[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
        int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] >= '1' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    int[][] dist = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
                    for (int x = 0; x < MAXN; x++) {
                        Arrays.fill(dist[x], INF);
                    }
                    Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
                    dist[i][j] = 0;
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] cell = q.poll();
                        int x = cell[0];
                        int y = cell[1];
                        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                            int nx = x + dx[k];
                            int ny = y + dy[k];
                            if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n &&
                                grid[nx][ny] >= '0' && grid[nx][ny] <= '9' &&
                                dist[nx][ny] > dist[x][y] + 1) {
                                dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                                q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                            if (target[x][y] >= '1' && target[x][y] <= '9' &&
                                dist[x][y] <= T && dist[x][y] <= distStart[x][y]) {
                                addEdge(id[i][j], id[x][y] + total, INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic());
    }
}
